title: Oka coherence and local coherent free resolutions

items.title: Oka coherence and local coherent free resolutions
items.statement: Assume AC. On every finite-dimensional complex manifold M the holomorphic structure sheaf O_M is coherent: the relation sheaf of any finite tuple of local holomorphic sections is locally finitely generated. Coherent O_M-modules are closed under kernels, cokernels and finite extensions. For every coherent F, point x and finite integer l≥0, there is a chart neighborhood W of x on which F has an exact partial free resolution O_W^{p_l}→…→O_W^{p_0}→F|_W→0 by finite ranks. Exactness at the leftmost term is not asserted. No global analytic free resolution is claimed.
items.strategy: Prove the Weierstrass-induction relation lemma with generators uniform on one neighborhood, following Demailly II3.19–3.20. Handle zero/unit tuple entries and coordinate changes. Prove the elementary coherent-kernel calculus and obtain each finite partial resolution by successive coherent kernels and finite shrinking. Stalk Noetherianity alone is insufficient.
items.axiom_base: ZF + full AC; record resolutions, countable shrinking/diagonal choices, Baire/Fréchet arguments and supplier-inherited choice uses precisely. No physical premise.

title: Oka coherence and local coherent free resolutions — Examples

items.title: A holomorphic relation kernel on a bidisc
items.statement: For (z_1,z_2):O^2→O on a bidisc, its relation sheaf is generated by (-z_2,z_1); show local exactness including the origin by power-series division.
items.strategy: Prove divisibility and gluing, not just away-from-origin rank.
items.axiom_base: ZF + AC inherited from the theorem; no physical premise.
